personas.name: The gift giver
personas.description: 28–45, buys sets for birthdays and the holidays, wants something that looks considered and arrives on time.

offers.rules: One discount a season: 20% sitewide on Black Friday and Cyber Monday only. Gift-with-purchase the rest of the year. No stacked codes.
never: No fake countdowns or 'last chance' that isn't

claims_never: Treats, cures, heals or prevents acne, eczema or rosacea

angles.A1: Visible result — show the skin, don't claim the result
angles.A2: Problem → solution — tight, flaky, stinging skin
angles.A3: Social proof — real reviews, word for word
angles.A5: Value math — price per use, minis before full size
angles.A6: Identity — for people who hate 12-step routines
angles.A7: Gift / occasion — the set that looks considered
angles.A8: Behind the formula — why each ingredient is there
angles.A9: Swap — replace three products with one

creative.doctrine: Angle decides scale, hook decides survival. Kill a hook at 1,000 impressions if the 3-second rate is under 20% or cost per order is over 1.5x target; judge a concept at 7 days and an angle at 14 days on cost per order. Never retire an angle until 3 concepts have failed it.
creative.production_rules: Masters stay evergreen unless the brief names a season: no dates, prices or offers burned into the film; the last 2 seconds are a separate end card so an offer drops in without a re-edit. Real skin, no heavy retouching, captions on every video.

standing_brief:
# Standing brief — Fernlight (example)

The office's house rules. The lead's morning huddle overrides anything here for the day;
this file is what still holds when the huddle hasn't said otherwise. Edit it, push, and the
next sweep uses it.

> Fernlight is a made-up brand used to show how the office works. Replace every line with your own.

## The brand
Fernlight makes barrier-first skincare for people who want fewer steps: a cleanser, a serum,
a moisturizer, and a body oil. Mid-premium ($18–$49), sold on our website, Amazon and TikTok Shop.
Promise: **calm, healthy-looking skin with fewer steps.**
Voice: clear, warm, a little witty. Explain the science in plain words. Never preach.

## This season (now → end of December)
- Focus: **holiday gifting**, then the **New Year routine reset** in January.
- Hero products: the Discovery Set ($49) for gifting; the Cloud Barrier Moisturizer for the reset.
- One discount only: **20% sitewide on Black Friday and Cyber Monday.** Gift-with-purchase the rest of the season.
  No other percentages in copy, no stacked codes, no fake countdowns.

## Always
- Show real skin with texture. Hands applying product. Daylight.
- Every hook names a person, a moment or a problem ("for the friend who has 12 steps and no time").
- Plays need an owner, a format, a date and a reason we would win.

## Never
- Medical claims: treats, cures, heals, prevents (acne, eczema, rosacea).
- "Clinically proven" or "dermatologist recommended" unless the study is linked.
- "Chemical-free", "toxin-free", "detox", "miracle", "flawless", "anti-aging".
- Before/after pictures framed as medical results.

## Team
- **Jordan** (brand lead) answers the huddle and approves anything that goes live.
- **Sam** owns content and social: TikTok, Instagram, creators, seeding.
- **Priya** owns performance and retention: paid ads, Amazon, email and SMS.
